section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1993
title: Incidenc: of Female Suicides by Causes During 1989 to 1993
pdf_title: Incidenc: of Female Suicides by Causes During 1989 to 1993
notes: It is well accepted that easy accessibility of means is an important factor in
culminating the desire to end one’s life.
2.4.1 ‘Poison’ because of its easy accessibility, remained, as in the past, the most
widely used means for committing ‘Suicides’. Other important means used were ‘Hanging’
(24.5%), ‘Burning by Fire’ (11.1%) and ‘Drowning’ (10.0%). These four means made up
for 80 per cent of the total suicides leaving 20 per cent share to other means, of which the
means adopted in 12 per cent of the suicides were not specified (TABLE-9).
